name: Standing Mark
description: Independent examination of claims and proposed agent actions, operated by Wheeler Hubbell Publishing, Inc. Returns signed results (WHP-STANDING-MARK-v1, Ed25519) stating what is established and what is not. Does not execute, authorize, pay or settle.

skills.name: Read the live contract
skills.description: GET /v1/contract: routes, payment terms, determinism rule, signed type, issuer key reference. Free.

skills.name: Request an examination
skills.description: POST /v1/evaluate with a claim or proposed action. Unpaid requests return HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms for exactly 1.00 USDC on Base (scheme exact: an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization to the pay_to address; the facilitator submits the transaction, so no customer ETH gas is required). Retry the same body with the signed x402 v2 envelope in the payment-signature (or x-payment) header; the service verifies then settles through the facilitator and returns the signed examination result.

skills.name: Verify a signed result
skills.description: Independent offline verification against the published issuer key is available in the public developer assets. The contract also lists POST /v1/verification for a signature-only check, but that route is not currently deployed (observed 2026-11-21).

x-note: This card describes the HTTP interface for A2A-capable agents. The service does not yet speak the A2A protocol natively; this card is an interoperability description, not a native A2A endpoint.
